method.coordinates: Integer original PNG pixels, top-left origin. Point pairs are measured from raw8-bit RGB screenshots, not JPEGs or resized tool previews.
method.profile: All three inspected PNGs declare an sRGB chunk with value00 (perceptual rendering intent); no ICC conversion was applied. Encoded RGB bytes are treated as sRGB under the standard transfer function. This is raster evidence, not a physical-display color measurement.
method.formula: For each8-bit channel v: c=v/255; linear=c/12.92 if c<=0.04045, else ((c+0.055)/1.055)^2.4. Y=0.2126*Rlinear+0.7152*Glinear+0.0722*Blinear. Contrast=(max(Y1,Y2)+0.05)/(min(Y1,Y2)+0.05), rounded to3 decimals.
method.foregroundChoice: Protected text points match opaque native core colors in the actual raster: primary240,233,218; supporting202,200,196; scenic-action gold224,191,123. Utility body/rim/edge samples intentionally retain the multicolor authored layers rather than pretending the icon is flat text.
method.backdropChoice: Nearby actual composited pixels are backdrop proxies. They include existing material, shadows and scene texture. They do not reconstruct the exact background hidden beneath an opaque glyph.
method.tooling: Read-only Python standard-library PNG chunk/decompression/filter decoding and direct integer RGB access; no image transformation, resampling, retouching or native/controller operation. Temporary analysis helper remains disposable under/private/tmp.

interpretation.pause: No full-control failure is asserted. Weak light/brass patches coexist with distinct dark contours and stronger nearby portions. The essential pause affordance remains recognizable in the supplied whole-frame baseline review.
interpretation.trail: SkyShowerTrail owns the ordinary dark under-track, pale rail, actual forecast miniatures and progress geometry. Glow/dust/faint trailing light are decoration. SkyTrailMotion deliberately fades followers only at the endpoint. The supplied paused/settled rail pairs do not establish an active timing-head, approaching/arriving state or moving-miniature contrast failure.
interpretation.protectedRoles: These actual opaque text-core/proxy pairs show local protection working in default phone, actual AX5 tablet and fully lit Sunny reader contexts. They are not every-glyph, worst-painting or every-state certification.
interpretation.candidate: Compare only a small scenic backing variant in the official shared utility owner. Design/register the contextual role before use; retain full target, fixed glyph geometry and existing enabled/pressed/focused semantics. ObservatoryIcon renders original artwork, so a foregroundStyle change alone does not recolor its essential body. Leave the comet trail unchanged on this evidence.

limits: Local point pairs are not whole-glyph minima, a whole-control pass/fail threshold, an isolated-backdrop reconstruction or a global contrast audit.
Body, brass, dark contour, shadow and adjacent texture each contribute differently; do not select a weak decorative layer and call all essential ink failed.
These are three selected native simulator stills, not the complete7locations x5milestones x3compositions intersection survey, active motion sequence or physical-device evidence.
Ordinary essential text has the repository proposed4.5:1 baseline. This record does not apply that text threshold automatically to a multicolor nontext utility or decorative rail.

No new actual VoiceOver, physical comfort/performance, minimum-iOS, human recognition or animation acceptance. Prior source-bound visual passes remain bounded and are not withdrawn by these local samples.
